Subject: Seller Verification & Evidence Request — Order OD438890793307262100 (Flipkart)

Hello Flipkart Support Team,

I am requesting seller verification details for my order (OD438890793307262100) concerning "TRIGGR Wukong 35dB  ANC, 4-mic ENC, Dual  Pairing, 60H Battery,  Monkey-king Design, v6.0  Bluetooth".
Identified Seller on Invoice/Order: Shreyash Retail Private Limited
Issue Category: DAMAGED_GOODS
RESOLVEGRAPH Case Reference: RG-1469

Please request the seller to confirm and provide any available records from the following:
1. Product condition photograph before packing: Pre-dispatch image showing intact product surface/seals, if captured.
2. Quality inspection records: Pre-dispatch QC checklist or seal verification record.
3. Packing photographs: Photographs showing protective cushioning and outer packaging prior to handover.
4. Packaging-condition records: Warehouse or courier handover packaging condition notes.
5. Dispatch information: Carrier handover receipt, tracking number, and dispatch date.

Please share the seller response or reference number through this support ticket so I can upload it to my complaint record.
